question: Does training a 4B monitoring coprocessor on measured incremental intervention value improve assistance at a fixed attention and compute budget?
action_naming_note: Our defer means wait; learning-to-defer papers use defer for expert handoff.
preconditions_before_collection: Opaque runtime directories and actor-visible observations without case, split or treatment labels
Counterbalance task, injected fault and budget factors; compare healthy and faulty variants with the same task instructions and limits
Exact raw-to-visible observation receipts after normalization and token packing
Common public transcript, artifact and scientific-criteria checkpoint for each continuation pair
Durable incident identity with active, resolved and reopened states
Executed dispatch receipts separate from model proposals and gate decisions
Needed-feedback availability and worker acknowledgment events, distinct from cancellation bookkeeping
Runner-enforced global native-role and per-continuation budgets, with owned-process cleanup
Independent outcome verification that accepts correctly reported original scientific failures

branches_per_pair: wait under the same downstream policy
collection_pilot.purpose: Validate checkpoint comparability, outcome measurements and reward sensitivity; not establish model effectiveness
collection_pilot.intervention_selection: Prespecify the experimental route from public evidence before observing either branch outcome; retain route selection provenance. This two-branch pilot does not measure all four action alternatives.
collection_pilot.native_sampling: Backend sampling is not claimed deterministic or controlled by a shared seed
collection_pilot.scientific_work: Actual native workers and retained simulation/diagnostic workflows; clearly identify any injected defects

required_situations: Long healthy progress and expected negative scientific checks
Useful preemptive assistance supported by predictive context
Diagnostic or simulation anomaly requiring attention
Harness defect requiring a fresh independent authority judge
Resolved incident and stale failure text
Indistinguishable observations with different hidden fault labels, used to detect impossible supervision

reward.quality: Independent reporting/progress verification, including faithfully reported falsification; never judge approval or physics-pass count alone
reward.unknown_measurements: Preserve the trajectory and withhold the unmeasured paired scalar; never fill in zero or invented counterfactuals
reward.negative_native_outcomes: Retain complete measured worker and judge failures
reward.coefficient_selection: Sensitivity and quality-cost frontiers on development data only, before frozen test evaluation
reward.shaping: No action/grant bonus and no potential-based shaping in this stage

subsequent_model_study.gated_on: Collection pilot satisfies preconditions and provides meaningful measured intervention-value variation
subsequent_model_study.data: Reviewed observable-state supervision plus actual downstream continuation outcomes
controls: same supervised checkpoint plus paired-value RL
subsequent_model_study.optimization: Match optimizer updates, record all rollout/feedback costs, retain the categorical decision interface
subsequent_model_study.splits: Disjoint underlying tasks, defect mechanisms and prefixes; no coefficient or prompt tuning on frozen test tasks
subsequent_model_study.evaluation: Fresh live intervention-positive and healthy cases, repeated trajectories, and rare-incident mixtures
metrics: useful intervention recall at fixed wake budget
subsequent_model_study.claim_limit: No improved model is claimed until fresh measured comparisons support it
